# ZeperAi

> ZeperAi is an AI-powered creative platform and performance ad generation suite built for D2C brands, e-commerce stores, and high-velocity marketing teams.

ZeperAi enables brands and agencies to transform raw product photography and brand websites into full-funnel marketing campaigns, high-converting ad creatives, commercial lifestyle studio shots, and transparent cutouts in seconds. By combining multi-agent creative orchestration, automated copywriting, professional typography layout blueprints, and multi-format aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 4:5), ZeperAi eliminates expensive multi-week photoshoots and empowers growth marketers to rapidly test winning ad variants across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Shopify.

## Core Capabilities & Studios

- **Campaign Studio**: Autonomous 7-stage multi-agent campaign engine (Brand Analysis, Market Research, Competitor Research, Campaign Strategy, Creative Direction, Master Prompts, Visual Creatives) that turns any brand URL or brief into a complete, ready-to-deploy ad campaign with human-in-the-loop review gates.
- **Product Studio**: Place isolated products into photorealistic commercial environments (e.g., luxury marble, minimalist studio, outdoor nature, bathroom vanity, neon tech).
- **Influencer & Fashion Studio**: Generate on-model product placement and digital fashion styling with relatable Indian and global models without organizing costly talent casting.
- **Background Remover Pro**: Zero-cost, client-side WebAssembly/WebGL accelerated background extraction preserving fine edges, hair, glass reflections, and intricate packaging.
- **CGI & 3D Lighting Studio**: Studio-grade lighting rigs, reflections, and 3D composition for cutting-edge product staging.
- **Festival & Seasonal Campaigns**: Ready-to-use themed backdrops for Black Friday, Diwali, Christmas, Summer Sales, and flash promotions.
- **AI Copywriter & Scorecard**: Generate persuasive hooks, primary text, and headlines graded by predicted conversion scores.

## Key Facts & Specifications

- **Target Audience**: D2C founders, Shopify store owners, e-commerce performance marketers, and creative ad agencies.
- **Supported Export Formats**: High-resolution PNG, WebP, and JPG.
- **Supported Aspect Ratios**: 1:1 (Square), 9:16 (Stories/Reels/TikTok), 16:9 (Landscape/YouTube), 4:5 (Meta Feed).
- **Commercial Rights**: All paid and trial outputs include full commercial usage rights for digital marketing campaigns.
- **AI Infrastructure**: Google Vertex AI Enterprise Postpay & Google AI Studio with runtime dynamic provider hot-reloading.
- **Founder & Lead Engineer**: Ayush Vishwakarma
- **Support & Inquiries**: growth@zeperai.com | contact@zeperai.in
